scope: Independent read-only source review of the member Vault candidate probe repair and sanitized run-002 observation. No browser, test, build, or network operation was run.

verdict_a_acceptance.reason: Run member-vault-access-002 proves real admin web and extension sign-in in an owned disposable profile, but it used runner commit 6c0003b and failed at generic stage_operation_failed before inventory. The repaired runner at fc72f74 has not been run, so settled inventory and candidate observation after this repair remain runtime-pending. No member authentication or identity is established.

positive_evidence: The readiness predicates require the Vault heading and the selected Mine/Shared scope, and wait for the inventory spinner and Vault Refresh spinner to stop. They do not wait on the independent site-login spinner; the source comments identify site matching and password generation as separate work.

The observation crosses the page boundary only as booleans, fixed scope labels, and designated-candidate counts. The persisted lastVaultObservation likewise contains only fixed booleans/categories/counts. No item title, item id, page body, auth URL, session, credential value, or authenticated screenshot is emitted by this runner.

A visible Vault error is sampled as errorVisible. Once the inventory readiness predicate resolves, the read stage converts it to vault_inventory_error rather than treating the inventory as an empty candidate set.
The report explicitly says that a matching title is only a candidate and that member login, member identity, and organization-role acceptance are not claimed.
verdict_b_quality.caveat: If an error is visible while a readiness condition remains false, waitFor continues polling until its timeout; the last safe observation retains errorVisible=true, but the top-level failure category remains stage_operation_failed. This preserves evidence without identifying the error as the immediate cause. Run-002's exact failed predicate remains unknown; the spinner theory is only a hypothesis.

runtime_pending: A separately admitted guarded run of the repaired runner is required to determine whether inventory settles and to capture the safe predicate observations. Run-002 only verified admin sign-in before the inventory failure.
